import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Daten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 33, "setup_cost": 400, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "2": {"demand": 50, "setup_cost": 153, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "3": {"demand": 34, "setup_cost": 470, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "4": {"demand": 25, "setup_cost": 189, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "5": {"demand": 33, "setup_cost": 359, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "6": {"demand": 36, "setup_cost": 187, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "7": {"demand": 50, "setup_cost": 423, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "8": {"demand": 29, "setup_cost": 120, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "9": {"demand": 24, "setup_cost": 340, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "10": {"demand": 42, "setup_cost": 329, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3}
}

capacities = {
    "1": 36, "2": 77, "3": 41, "4": 22, "5": 39,
    "6": 47, "7": 68, "8": 27, "9": 33, "10": 49
}

# Modell erstellen
model = gp.Model()
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
production = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Gesamtkosten minimieren
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * setup[t] +
        period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * production[t] +
        period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * inventory[t]
        for t in period_data.keys()
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for t in period_data.keys():
    t_int = int(t)
    # Nachfrage decken
    if t_int == 1:
        model.addConstr(production[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[t] + inventory[str(t_int - 1)] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    
    # Kapazitätsbeschränkung
    model.addConstr(production[t] <= capacities[t] * setup[t])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[t] >= 0)

# Optimierung
model.optimize()

# Ergebnisse
production_plan = {t: int(production[t].X) for t in period_data.keys()}
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Ausgabe
result = {
    "production": production_plan,
    "objective_value": objective_value
}

print(result)
```
